quote: Over a 10 years of developmnent and over a bilion of dollars for game like this is a slap to the face. author: youngdumbledore
quote: It's a great way to experience dnd campaign in video game. It has a great story, interesting characters, and many possibilities for character creation and building as well as how you want to approach the game. There are tons of content and I would dare to say it's impossible to discover it all during ur first playthrough. I just hope they will add some additional content such as spells and equipment because it would add more interesting choices to make to an already complex game.
